# NEOM Panels — Complete Corporate, Product & Technical Specification Reference (llms-full.txt)

Website: https://neompanels-new.vercel.app
Parent Company: NEOM Panels
Tagline: ENGINEERED EXCELLENCE, DESIGNED FOR SPACES
Primary Headline: Wood panels. Long-term thinking.
Manufacturing Base: India (Company-owned wood-panel manufacturing facility)

## 1. Corporate Identity & Brand Structure
NEOM Panels manufactures wood-panel products for furniture, interior projects and industrial packaging. Our brands, Starwoods and NEOM Packing Plywood, serve manufacturers, contractors, procurement teams and trade partners across India.

- **NEOM Panels (Parent Manufacturing Company)**
  - Operates an in-house wood-panel production facility in India.
  - Controls veneer grading, moisture conditioning, multi-ply cross-laminated layup, hot-press resin bonding, thickness calibration, 4-stage factory inspection and palletised B2B dispatch.
- **Starwoods (A NEOM Panels Brand — Furniture & Interiors)**
  - Serves furniture manufacturers, modular kitchen and wardrobe fabricators, commercial interior contractors and regional channel partners.
  - URL: https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands#starwoods
- **NEOM Packing Plywood (A NEOM Panels Brand — Industrial Packaging)**
  - Offers moisture-resistant (MR) packaging-grade plywood for business buyers sourcing material for packing cases, crates, dividers and protective enclosures.
  - URL: https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands/neom-packing-plywood

## 2. Verified NEOM Packing Plywood Specifications
- **Product Category**: Packaging-grade plywood
- **Grade**: Moisture Resistant (MR)
- **Supply Coverage**: India — B2B supply for packaging manufacturers, packing-case fabricators, industrial buyers and trade suppliers
- **Available Technical Documents**: Product specification sheets and handling guidance provided on individual review against requirement scope
- **Grade Guidance**: Moisture-resistant plywood is not waterproof. Confirm suitability against the expected storage, handling and transport conditions before ordering.
- **Application Categories**:
  1. Packing cases
  2. Crates and protective enclosures
  3. Dividers, liners and packaging panels
- **Purchasing Options**: One-time batch orders and recurring monthly/quarterly industrial supply.

## 3. Manufacturing Workflow (4 Stages)
1. **Material selection**: Reviewing incoming timber, veneer and adhesive inputs and aligning substrate selection with the intended furniture, interior or industrial packaging application.
2. **Production**: Layup, pressing, conditioning, calibration and edge-trimming at our manufacturing facility in India, set to the required sheet dimensions and nominal thickness.
3. **Dimensional and surface checks**: Inspecting panel thickness uniformity, length and width tolerances, diagonal squareness, edge integrity and surface condition before release.
4. **Packing and dispatch**: Sorting verified sheets into protected pallet lots matched to purchase orders, brand and grade markings, and buyer delivery schedules.
